name: vintage-lace-girl-golden-hour-closeup
image_vibe: Warm golden-hour lace editorial, sepia vintage film, quiet intimate nostalgia
image_purpose: Create a detailed close-up fashion portrait with dramatic sunlight and analog texture.

prompt.project_info: A cinematic close-up portrait in warm golden-hour light with vintage editorial styling.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with messy dark-auburn hair loosely pinned up and soft tendrils framing her face. She wears a flowing muted-beige vintage lace blouse with delicate floral patterns and an opaque lining, plus a large bohemian gold hoop earring with amber glass beads.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up framing, neutral earthy softly blurred background, one earring catching light, and a diagonal shaft of sunlight across the shoulder and neck.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High contrast between illuminated warm highlights and deep soft shadows, golden-hour glow, subtle lens flare, soft-focus edges, and quiet nostalgic intimacy.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm film, shallow depth of field, rich warm sepia-leaning grade, visible fine grain, detailed lace, hair, and jewelry texture, editorial fashion photography.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic close-up editorial portrait of an original adult woman in warm golden-hour light. Give her messy dark-auburn hair loosely pinned up with soft tendrils framing her face, and dress her in a flowing muted-beige vintage lace blouse with delicate floral patterns and an opaque lining. Add a large intricate bohemian gold hoop earring made of golden metal and amber glass beads catching the light. Use a dramatic diagonal shaft of sunlight across her shoulder and neck, strong contrast between warm highlights and deep soft shadows, a softly blurred earthy background, 35mm film, fine grain, rich sepia-leaning color, subtle lens flare, and soft-focus edges.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent blouse, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: source golden-hour lace reference
assets.usage: Use only for lace blouse, diagonal sunlight, earring, close-up framing, and film treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the lace blouse, golden-hour shaft, bohemian earring, sepia 35mm treatment, and close-up composition. Keep the subject original adult and blouse opaque-lined.

changes: Specified an opaque blouse lining and added safety exclusions while preserving the lace editorial concept.
